Name: ContosoFortSynqly
Author: ContosoFort
Description:
The [ContosoFort](https://www.contosofort.io) Microsoft Sentinel Solution provides a dedicated content hub presence for ContosoFort integrations delivered through the Synqly platform. Data is collected by the Synqly connector and written to ASIM-normalized tables in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace.

This solution is dependent on the Synqly solution to collect the data. The Synqly solution must be installed separately.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies:

a. [Synqly Integration Platform](https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/synqlyinc1759267074521.azure-sentinel-solution-synqly-integration)
